svg.title: Implementation dependency graph and critical path
svg.desc: Directed acyclic graph showing which tasks depend on which, with the critical path highlighted in teal
svg.text: Longest dependency chain: 9 steps. Parallelisable: H2,H3,H4,H5 in P0; I2 alongside I1/I3; A1–A5 after C1.
Effort estimate (solo developer with existing FEM knowledge)
Total: ~8 weeks sequential. With P0+P1 parallel: ~6 weeks. P3 is the longest phase — A5 (solver unification) is the largest single task.
All existing analyses keep running throughout: each phase is designed as a non-breaking incremental change on top of current code.
